Opposite Parties
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Kumar Harshvardhan, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Md. Mushtaque Alam, App
 For the Informant : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Singh, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar

ORAL ORDER 7 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
2. Pursuant to the last order of this Court, the S.H.O. and the I.O. of the case have appeared and they have assisted this Court in the matter.
3. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Bhorey P.S. Case No.58 of 2024 registered under sections 420, 406, 409, 467, 468, 469 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.

4. On earlier occasion, the learned counsel for the petitioner had submitted that the main thrust of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.22001 of 2025(7) dt.07-11-2025 allegation is against co-accused Manish Kumar Pandit.

sentences.text: Considering the above argument, this Court had granted interim bail to the petitioner and had issued notice to said Manish Kumar Pandit and today he has appeared through his lawyer.

6. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2- Manish Kumar Pandit and learned APP for the State assisted by the S.H.O. have taken this Court to various statements, from which it appears that it is the petitioner who had done the entire cheating and defalcation.
The petitioner was the owner of the C.S.P. centre.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts, the interim bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 15.10.2025 is hereby cancelled and this bail application is rejected.
8. The personal appearance of the police officials is hereby dispensed with.
9. The trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same at the earliest.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) pawan/-
